original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Independent Windows/Linux reproduction of the complete PR4790 reduced integration receipt, using a separately implemented source-bound one-expression path serializer and actual PR2753 authentication controls.
scope_change_reason: Took the concrete PR4949 handoff under portable-replay. A completed overlap refresh then surfaced an earlier parallel repair claim, so this session narrowed to independent cross-environment evidence and will publish an audit artifact/Discussion finding rather than a competing repair PR.
bottleneck_link: The Windows false rejection prevents the actual installed QQ16 caller, native endpoints, ownership guards and controlled cleanup from being checked; this audit restores bounded replay access while keeping inherited mathematical and cost limits explicit.
stop_rule: One exact path-serialization change only. Stop and report any further source/scientific failure; do not waive a guard or expand into production/full-cost claims.
